Migration done. 12 files converted, 36 call sites:

- `packages/accounts`: `repo/session.js`, `service/teamService.js`, `admin/apiKeyAdmin.js`
- `packages/billing`: `repo/refund.js`, `service/couponService.js`
- `packages/catalog`: `repo/supplier.js`, `admin/variantAdmin.js`
- `packages/orders`: `repo/shipment.js`, `service/returnService.js`
- `packages/support`: `repo/sla.js`, `admin/macroAdmin.js`
- `packages/analytics`: `repo/cohort.js`

Shape: `db.query(sql, params)` → `db.execute({ sql, params })`. All package files pass `node --check`.

Left alone on purpose:

- `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` — 2 `db.query` calls remain. File header says vendored legacy-orm 2.1.4, "Do not edit — it is replaced wholesale on every upgrade, and local changes are silently lost." Needs upstream fix or wrapper, your call.
- `cache.query(...)` — different object, unrelated API, untouched.
